extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation. The benchmark contains 1,825 diverse tasks spanning nine domains (Game Development, SVG Generation, Web Applications, Simulations, Data Science, Management Systems, Multimedia Editing, Quick Tools, Others) to evaluate LLMs' ability to transform multimodal instructions into high-quality, executable interactive visual artifacts.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Multi-stage pipeline combining expert sourcing with LLM generation and refinement. Candidates aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots. Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics (state changes, animations, responsiveness).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Two-stage filtering: (i) MinHash + semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS; (ii) screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts. Flagged items are re-authored or discarded.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items. Two-stage de-duplication filtering using MinHash + semantic similarity and screenshot perceptual hashing. Experts rewrite prompts for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify. Tasks solved only by brittle hacks (e.g., hard-coded coordinates) are revised or removed.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. LLM-draft and then human-refine for specificity and screenability. A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen's κ≥0.8 among annotators; the seed is reused as few-shot references. The 10 items are grouped into five vision-oriented and five code-oriented dimensions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen's κ≥0.8 among annotators
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Multiple engineers with extensive front-end development experience for human validation study (280 queries, 6 models)
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Hunyuan-Turbos for checklist generation, Gemini-2.5-Pro and Qwen2.5-VL-72B as MLLM referees for automated scoring
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Privacy dimension in quality filtering ensures questions avoid requesting or involving any sensitive personal information, such as phone numbers, addresses, or other identifiable details
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current methodology evaluates dynamic behavior by capturing screenshots at fixed intervals, which may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions. The benchmark focuses on evaluating final artifact quality from single-turn prompts and does not assess agentic capabilities for iterative refinement, debugging, or multi-step development processes.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation for evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifact generation. The benchmark is designed to assess visual fidelity, interactive correctness, and code quality across diverse domains including web applications, games, simulations, data visualizations, and SVG generation.
